prereg_list: E2w early exit on PROD avoid tail, weekly check

extra_variants.X1: E0 with idle cash earning the Nifty 1D Rate index. Reason: E2/E3 park proceeds in cash at the 1D rate while the frozen baseline earns 0 on idle cash; X1 isolates the rule effect from the cash-yield effect. E2/E3 are tested vs E0 (as specified) and vs X1; adoption requires passing both.
extra_variants.X2: E1 + the better of E2w/E2d by DEV paired t; run ONLY if E1 and at least one early-exit rule individually pass the adoption rule on DEV.

conventions: Early-exit trigger = per-date percentile of PROD among elig_base rows with finite PROD (same definition as the avoid list); a held name with no PROD on the check date is held (frequency reported).

E2w checks on the book weekly signal dates inside the hold (sleeve start +5,+10,+15 trading days); E2d checks every trading day inside the hold; exit at the entity next open; proceeds earn the Nifty 1D Rate until the sleeve rebalance.
E3 checks every close inside the hold; exit next open; proceeds at Nifty 1D Rate.
E1 carried positions are reset to 1/20 of the new sleeve equity; the small trim/top-up trades are not charged (stated approximation).
S1 weights proportional to 1/vol_20 among valid picks, capped at 2x equal weight, iteratively renormalised; total invested = (#valid picks)/20 like slot sizing.
Excess vs random always uses the frozen 5-seed horizon-matched random top-20 (E0 rules, same mask).
Capacity: idle cash (unfilled slots, capped excess) earns the Nifty 1D Rate in ALL capacity books incl. random (which pays impact on its own picks) and the zero-impact reference row.
Tax: calendar-year realisation; STT (0.1% buy + 0.1% sell) is not deductible from capital gains (s.48), so taxable gain = net P&L + STT paid.

item2_exits.X2_definition: not run: E1 pass=True, best early-exit rule E2w pass=False

predeclared_amendment.X3: ADDED AFTER seeing E1 results (disclosed post-hoc addition; it uses the slot pre-declared as unused). E1 as literally specified decides at the rebalance CLOSE whether to sell at that same close using the PROD signal computed from that close, which violates house rule 6 (decisions use data <= t, trades fill at open t+1 or later). X3 = executable carry: every position due at the rebalance close is held through the close; at the next open the names not in the new top-20 are sold (legacy, exit cost charged there) and names still in the new top-20 are carried untouched. Adoption verdict for carry rests on X3, not on E1. Variant count increases by one.

html_tables.title: 1. Does the stock-picking book beat simple alternatives? (frozen PROD vs single model vs 3-seed ensemble)
html_tables.note: Phase-averaged (weekly book started on each of the 5 weekdays, averaged). Excess = annualised mean daily difference; t-stats are Newey-West (lag 20). 2026 is a holdout never used for selection. The Nifty 500 is a price index (dividends ~1.2%/yr missing) while lab stock prices include dividends, so the random/equal-weight books are the fair yardsticks. PROD stays the production score regardless (pre-registered).

html_tables.note: Holding positions through the rebalance night and trading at the next open earns the close-to-open move, which was strongly positive for Indian stocks in 2023-2026. Random picks gain almost as much from the same timing, so the model's skill (excess vs a random book with the same timing) is essentially unchanged.

html_tables.title: 5. Capacity: returns after market impact by fund size (frozen book)
html_tables.note: Each name gets AUM/80. Impact per side = Y x daily vol x sqrt(position / 20-day median traded value), capped at 10%, plus 50 bps base cost. Capped policies hold at most 5% of a name's ADV and leave the rest in cash. Idle cash earns the Nifty 1D Rate. References: equal-weight universe CAGR 0.1122 (2023-25) / 0.0860 (2026); Nifty 500 price 0.1659 / -0.1093.

html_tables.note: Simplified calendar-year model: tax paid each year-end from the book; short-term losses carried forward; STT (0.1% buy + 0.1% sell) is not deductible from capital gains, so taxable gain = net P&L + STT. not_adoptable.E1: passes the statistical rule but its keep/sell decision at the rebalance close uses that close's signal (house rule 6); superseded by X3
